display: Ptycho-Weak-Lensing — shear, mass map, pointings, polarization
descriptive: Simulates a lens (a convergence map κ), observes it through galaxies with random intrinsic shapes, recovers κ by inverting the spin-2 shear field, checks the recovery against E/B, rotation and calibration nulls, and reconstructs κ from overlapping pointings by a ptychographic iteration; polarization Q+iU goes through the same E/B machinery.

operators.role: γ̂ = D κ̂ and κ̂ = D* γ̂; |D| = 1 for k ≠ 0, D(0) := 0 (the mass sheet is not measured)

operators.english: Re and Im of D* applied to any spin-2 field
operators.role: lens signal is E; B is the systematics/null channel; same operator for polarization Q+iU

operators.english: pointing window × galaxy count, and source-plane efficiency D_ls/D_s
operators.role: the probe of pointing j and its lensing scale

operators.english: κ ← κ + α Re[D* M_j (ε_j − η_j D κ)]/η_j
operators.role: Kaczmarz over pointings with the object constraint κ real (B = 0)

ordering.english: build the convergence map, solve the Poisson equation by FFT with zero padding, take the second derivatives; the mean of κ drops out (mass sheet).
divide by (1−κ) for the reduced shear, apply it exactly to each galaxy's random intrinsic ellipticity.
bin and smooth the galaxies; the noise is σ_e/√N per smoothing area.
Kaiser–Squires with the reduced-shear iteration; κ_B and the 45° rotation are the controls.
each pointing is a probe window; ePIE over the pointings with B = 0 fills the gaps the naive mosaic leaks into.

verify.descriptive: Exact self-checks against closed-form results; a mismatch is a code fault, not a result.

ordering.english: unit modulus of the spin-2 kernel for every k ≠ 0.
γ_t(r) = κ̄(<r) − κ(r) against the closed form; γ_× vanishes.
γ → κ_E recovers κ up to the mass sheet; B ≈ 0.
adding a constant to κ leaves γ unchanged.
a spin-2 field built from a scalar potential has B = 0.
a known multiplicative bias is recovered within the statistical error.

ptycho.descriptive: Reconstructs κ from overlapping pointings and compares with naive stacking on the covered area.

ordering.english: place cosine-tapered square pointings with overlap; some are left unobserved (gaps).
each pointing has its own window, galaxy density, efficiency and shape noise.
efficiency-rescaled count-weighted stack, then one Kaiser–Squires.
Kaczmarz over pointings in random order with κ real; track χ² and the B-mode leak.
correlation and rms against the truth on the covered area.
ε → iε moves the lens from E to B; κ_E must lose it.
